approved_context.quote: For this backup requirement, use AES-256-GCM.

anchor.statement: Backup archives must use AES-256-GCM encryption.

cases.rationale: The explicit approved clarification authorizes the selected algorithm; this is authorized precision. Production currently omits this context.

approved_context.quote: Do not select an algorithm; leave that choice open.

anchor.statement: Backup archives must use AES-256-GCM encryption.

cases.rationale: The same algorithm commitment invents policy against the approval context. The production-visible anchor is identical to the authorized case.

anchor.statement: Terminal messages, trace files and saved reports must omit access tokens.

cases.rationale: One omission predicate applied uniformly across several output surfaces is one invariant.
